title: Computational simulation of JAK/STAT signaling in somatic versus germline stem cells.
journal: Developmental dynamics : an official publication of the American Association of Anatomists
one_liner_zh: 该文用常微分方程模拟JAK/STAT信号通路中STAT磷酸化动态，虽涉及转录因子STAT，但未聚焦蛋白-DNA互作、结合位点或复合物建模，且方法为通路级动力学模拟而非AI/分子模拟，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: The Janus kinase/signal transducer and activator of transcription (JAK/STAT) signaling pathway regulates a variety of cellular processes. A major activation event in this pathway involves the phosphorylation of a tyrosine of STAT, converting unphosphorylated STAT (uSTAT) to phosphorylated STAT (pSTAT), an active transcription factor. In a noncanonical role, uSTAT contributes to the maintenance of heterochromatin stability. As such, an increase in pSTAT concurrently reduces uSTAT, resulting in heterochromatin loss, as observed in Drosophila somatic tissues. Paradoxically, an opposing phenomenon occurs in Drosophila male germline stem cells (GSCs), where the JAK/STAT pathway remains persistently active due to a continuous supply of ligands. Here, computational simulations were employed to dissect JAK/STAT pathway activation under different cellular contexts, mimicking somatic and germline cells. In these simulations, ordinary differential equations were leveraged to replicate the chemical reactions governing JAK/STAT signaling under different conditions. RESULTS: The outcomes indicate that transient ligand stimulation, typical in somatic tissues, led to a momentary reduction in uSTAT levels. Conversely, sustained ligand stimulation, a characteristic feature of the GSC niche, resulted in elevated uSTAT levels at equilibrium. CONCLUSION: The simulation suggests that the duration of ligand exposure could explain the observed opposite effects of JAK/STAT activation on heterochromatin in somatic versus GSCs.
abstract_zh: 背景：Janus激酶/信号转导与转录激活因子（JAK/STAT）信号通路调控多种细胞过程。该通路中的一个主要激活事件涉及STAT酪氨酸的磷酸化，将未磷酸化STAT（uSTAT）转化为磷酸化STAT（pSTAT），后者是一种活性转录因子。在非经典作用中，uSTAT有助于维持异染色质稳定性。因此，pSTAT的增加同时减少uSTAT，导致异染色质丢失，如在果蝇体细胞组织中所观察到的。矛盾的是，在果蝇雄性生殖干细胞（GSCs）中发生相反现象，其中JAK/STAT通路因配体的持续供应而保持持续激活。此处，采用计算模拟来剖析不同细胞背景下JAK/STAT通路的激活，模拟体细胞和生殖细胞。在这些模拟中，利用常微分方程复制不同条件下调控JAK/STAT信号传导的化学反应。结果：结果表明，瞬时配体刺激（体细胞组织中的典型特征）导致uSTAT水平短暂降低。相反，持续配体刺激（GSC微环境的特征）在平衡状态下导致uSTAT水平升高。结论：模拟提示，配体暴露持续时间可能解释JAK/STAT激活在体细胞与GSCs中对异染色质观察到的相反效应。
